agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 annual report and financial statements audited by Mirawati Sensi Idris and granted full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: The 2025 net income of Rp2.54 trillion was allocated to reserve funds (Rp2 billion) and retained earnings for working capital, with no cash dividend distributed.
Agenda #3: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to set Director salaries for 2026, while Commissioner salaries were set to at least match 2025 levels.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint an OJK-registered independent auditor for the 2026 fiscal year.
Agenda #5: The Board reported the utilization of 2025 Bond and Sukuk proceeds for BSD City infrastructure (Rp403.53 billion) and working capital (Rp118.37 billion).
Agenda #6: The Board of Commissioners reported the appointment of Teddy Pawitra, Rudiantara, and Rizal E. Halim to the Audit Committee for a term ending in 2029.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved amendments to Articles 3, 48, and 66 of the Articles of Association regarding business activities and board membership composition.
Agenda #8: The meeting approved the resignation of Muktar Widjaja and Michael Jackson Purwanto Widjaja and the appointment of Teky Mailoa as President Commissioner for a term ending in 2030.
Agenda #9: The Board of Directors was authorized to formalize meeting resolutions in a notary deed and submit changes to the Company's Articles of Association to the Minister of Law.
Agenda #10: The company submitted an official electronic report for which it holds full responsibility; further details are not stated.
